cards.hint: Look for the signing date in the opening sentence.
cards.quote: signed on September 17, 1787, established the government of the United States.
cards.stem: On what date was the finished document signed?

cards.hint: Think of the city with the State House.
cards.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787
cards.stem: In which city did the Federal Convention convene?

cards.hint: Recall the debate over power of the central authority.
options: how much power to allow the central government
how many representatives in Congress to allow each state
to revise the Articles of Confederation
cards.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government
cards.stem: What was one chief point at issue for the delegates?

checks.message: every quiz text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 3 card quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quote-verbatim)
every card's correct answer options[0] occurs in its quote after normalisation (answer-in-quote)
every card has distinct options after normalisation (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
quiz-cards-v1: no weakening — every one of the 1 changed field(s) sits under the affected paths recomputed from revision 1, item counts and ids are stable, and no tolerance increased
